shortDescription: List Directories in a File Share

options.name: account_name
options.description: Storage Account Name Provided by Azure Portal

options.name: connection_string
options.description: String that include URL & Token to connect to Azure Storage Account. Provided by Azure Portal Storage Account -> Access Keys -> Connection String

options.name: path
options.description: path, directory, whose directories must be listed. If not present, path is the root of the File Share

options.name: share
options.description: Name of the share to be managed
